notes.title: Patch - March 28th, 2025
notes.notes:
[h3]Quilters!

The [b]latest patch is now live[/b] on Steam! In this one, we’ve introduced fixes and improvements, and everyone’s favorite - [b]new Seasonal Content[/b]!

That’s right, [b]Sakura Season is arriving in [i]Quilts and Cats of Calico[/i] on March 31[/b]!

We hope you’ve been enjoying our seasonal updates, especially the most recent [b]Ramadan Content[/b].

Check out the full patch notes below, and don’t forget to update your game so you’re ready to fully enjoy the Sakura Seasonal Content when it drops on March 31 (yes, I’m repeating myself but it’s just so cute!).

Patch Notes: 
[list]
[*] Added missing hints for some optional mini-games in campaign mode 
[*] Objectives/Limited Rules pop-up was re-scaled to fit ultra wide resolutions 
[*] Objectives/Limited Rules icons will no longer go beyond the designated window
[*] Minor optimizations 
[*] Seasonal content for upcoming event added to the game 
[/list][/h3]

notes.title: June 13th patch notes - The Summer Solstice event is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi there, everyone![/h2]

We thought we’d let you know about seasonal content for Quilts and Cats of Calico. We’ve got a pretty cozy plan and we’d like to share it with you. The short story is…

[h1]Starting today, seasonal content will be coming to the game and Summer Pawstice is already here![/h1]

Throughout the year, there are plenty of beautiful, colorful, and joyful occasions around the world worth celebrating. We want to give those events some love and we want to give you an opportunity to celebrate those in the game while sewing your quilts. It just so happens that one such event is just around the corner, and [b]starting now and until July 4th, you’ll be able to revel in the mysterious charm and eerie serenity of summer, with the Summer Solstice content[/b]. In this case, though, we’re pretty sure the cats would prefer to call it the Summer Pawstice. You know what? Let’s call it that to avoid any unnecessary scratches.

[h3]What do the Seasonal Decorations Include?[/h3]
Each of the events will come with its own, unique set of decorations that will include a seasonal background, as well as a set of new decorations for the Cat Editor. The background will let you feel the unique spirit of each of the events with every quilt you sew, and the oh-so-ever rowdy felines, adorned with the new decorations, will surely prove to be a fun addition, as well.

[h2]Also, here's a trailer showcasing the new and upcoming cosmetic additions:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=FCIIbvg0FQg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Which events will be celebrated?[/h3]
All around the year and all around the world, there are numerous occasions that call for celebration. And while we can’t possibly cover all of them, we chose some that we feel come together as an interesting and diverse package. Here’s the list of the events:
- Lunar New Year
- Valentine's Day
- Sakura
- Easter
- Ramadan
- Summer Solstice
- Halloween
- Christmas/Holiday

Both the backgrounds and decoration items will be available for a set amount of time, covering the corresponding celebration. And last but not least, and maybe best of all is that [b]each and every one of these updates will come as a free, temporary in-game seasonal feature![/b]

We hope you’ll celebrate all of these lovely, vibrant times of the year with us (and the cats). 

[h3]Patch notes![/h3]
Here are the details of the new features, changes and fixes mad in today's patch!

[b]New features:[/b][list]
[*] Story Mode Hint System - Players will have the ability to skip to a later stage of a puzzle or match in the story mode after failing it. There is a possibility to choose from 3 states of completion of the puzzle/match.
[*] In-game cat swapping - Players will now have the option to change cats used in the game to any of their created custom cats by clicking on cats' portraits.
[*] Story Mode - Optional mini-games are now indicated with a blue exclamation mark.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list]
[*] Objectives window is no longer missing a title in story mode games
[*] Glyph for exiting Online Challenge pop-up added
[*] Minor tweaks to props present on game boards
[*] Exiting the challenge will no longer go back to Main Menu but will instead go to Online Menu
[*] Cats will no longer be possible to pet through UI elements
[*] Game no longer freezes after achieving 99+ points
[*] Three digit points value will now be properly scaled and displayed
[*] Frank is no longer incorrectly called "Commander" in his end game puzzle
[*] Closing full tile bag view will now only happen when player presses the designated button, instead of accepting RMB (or its equivalent)
[*] Leftovers of D-pad navigation disabled
[*] Eye icon showing which board the player is looking at will now correctly display when joining an ongoing online game
[*] Minor fix to how refreshing market tiles in solo mode was working
[*] Profanity filter will now work when choosing online nickname
[*] Players will now have the ability to use various alphabets, instead of just the latin one, when choosing an online nickname
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b][list]
[*] Photo of Cylke the Cat added to credits
[*] Small tweak to Online Challenge generation algorithm
[*] Some localization updates
[*] Pressing RMB while holding a tile will now take it back to player's hand instead of placing it back on the board
[/list]
Take care, stay safe and cozy, and see you soon!

P.S. As always, feel free to join our Discord server to chat about your strategies, high scores and more, cats included. If you feel like there’s not enough adorable cat pictures in your life, the Discord server is also the place for you.

notes.title: April 22 patch notes - weekly Challenges (and more) are here!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey, Quilters![/h3]

It’s time for the first big content patch for Quilts and Cats of Calico. We all know it’s a cozy, relaxing game, right? The purring cats, vibrant colors and soothing music can be quite calming. On the other hand, though, we know it can be a challenge, especially when the player whose turn was right before you takes the yellow flower tile which was perfect for you and you oh so wanted and oh my why did they have to ruin my perfect quilt?!

[h2]Weekly Challenges are here[/h2]
Okay, let’s calm down. Today, we want to introduce a new kind of a challenge to the game, for those who like competing in rankings and perfecting their scores on a preset board. In these weekly contests, you’ll be aiming to become (one of) the best scoring quilters and if you manage to do so, your nickname - along with your score - will be visible to players all over the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/fc83be046ea53f64f67451e6e775522f5b9bcd09.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/43e639400d5b7131a54bc2af22b316dd3c00dc43.jpg[/img]

So how do the challenges work? Each week, a system designed for this specific purrpose (sorry, we had to) is going to draw from a bag of modes, AI difficulties, goals and rules to create an exciting premade game for everyone. Next - the puzzly fun begins! You’ll be able to play the challenge however many times you want to get that fluffy high score. Since there’s no randomness, you’ll be able to get a better score with each of your attempts. At the end of the week and for the entirety of the duration of the next challenge, 6 players with the highest scores will be put on the ranking board for all other quilters to see.

The first challenge is already available, so pounce right on in!

[h2]Limited Rules, QoL changes & patch notes[/h2]

But that’s not all we’ve prepared for today. Besides the Challenge Mode, there are also a few quality of life changes we’ve made. Most of these relate to how Limited Rules are displayed during the games. Before, it could’ve been hard for players to access the information, so we’ve made it a bit easier. Here’s the rundown:
[list]
[*] We’ve added an animation showing hexes you won’t be able to place tiles on, when playing using some of the limited rules
[*] During gameplay, limited rules are now visible in a separate window you can access at any time
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/340c9da77e29a521c8c222a9855ddc138f560506.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/d9bc91e0ca8ae4e5e0a311c7be7c77fa72df56e1.gif[/img]

And finally, here’s the list of other changes that went live with this update:
[list]
[*] Added a pop-up informing of campaign progress loss when starting new campaign run
[*] Added a contact field to the in-game report system
[*] Some minor bug fixes
[*] Some minor visual UI and VFX fixes
[/list]

So, if you think you’ve got what it takes to become one of the quiltest cat-lovers there is, we invite you to join in on the Weekly Challenge fun! Also, feel free to join our Discord server to chat about your strategies, high scores and more, cats included. If you feel like there’s not enough adorable cat pictures in your life, the Discord server is also the place for you.

[url=https://discord.gg/quilts-and-cats-of-calico-1034094500286570508][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309412/ab1a4ed608010f07ffe22c59e22f2b46b7e459c3.jpg[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy this new addition to the game and we can’t wait to see you on the ranking board! 

Take care!
